cons: Plus £5/year taken automatically if you don't downgrade after trial

Some high rates require Plus membership
reviewData.reviewBody:
TopCashback remains the benchmark for pure cashback in the UK. The model is simple: click through, shop as normal, and get the full commission back. Because it doesn't take a cut, it consistently beats Quidco and others on headline rates, especially for insurance, utilities and broadband where differences can be £20-£40.

The Classic account is genuinely free with no minimum payout for PayPal. The Plus tier (£5/year) lifts rates by around 5-10% and adds protection features, but you need to manually downgrade after the free trial if you don't want it. Withdrawals are fee-free and the gift card bonuses (Amazon, Tesco, M&S) add another 3-15% on top.

reviewData.reviewBody:
Quidco pioneered cashback in the UK and remains the closest competitor to TopCashback. The experience is almost identical: search retailer, click through, cashback tracks within hours and becomes payable after retailer return window. ClickSnap is its differentiator for groceries - scan receipts from Tesco, Sainsbury's, ASDA for branded products where TopCashback has no equivalent.

Basic is free forever. Premium costs £1 per active month (max £12/year) and raises rates and gives faster support. For pure online shopping TopCashback often wins on rate, but Quidco wins for in-store and receipt offers.

The downside is the quarterly schedule. If you need cash quickly, it's slower than TopCashback or Ibotta. But for pure percentage back, especially during 10-15% store events, it beats most US competitors.

Cashback rates are modest vs pure cashback sites. Its advantage is global availability - works in 200+ countries where TopCashback/Rakuten don't. Payout fees are a downside; Skrill is cheapest at $5 min.

name: Shopmium
description: Grocery cashback app with 8M users UK, France, US. Buy at Tesco, Sainsbury's, ASDA, upload receipt, barcode scan for PayPal cashback. Free product welcome.

reviewData.reviewBody:
Shopmium focuses on branded grocery cashback - think Kellogg's, PepsiCo, Nestlé - up to 100% free products. Buy at any supermarket, upload receipt within 2 days and scan barcode. Cashback is from 20p to £2 per product, often stackable with supermarket loyalty.

No minimum payout now - previously £10, now from 1p to PayPal. Welcome free product via referral code is genuine. Best for UK grocery shoppers wanting freebies.

$5 Amazon minimum reachable in ~1 month. No PayPal, only gift cards. Good as additional receipt stacker alongside Fetch.

Cashback rates are secondary to surveys and paid emails. It's US-only, so UK test used VPN for verification only; UK users should use InboxPounds instead.

£1.50 minimum is among lowest UK grocery apps. Payouts next morning after approval. Good if you buy healthy/sustainable brands, less useful for mainstream.

GasBuddy is fuel price search + savings. Real-time prices at 150k+ stations reported by users. Pay with GasBuddy+ Mastercard (Fifth Third Bank) gives 3¢/gal guaranteed every fill-up, 5¢ at select stations, plus c-store bonuses. No credit check - links checking account.

CashBack Deals separate: scan fuel/receipts 2 per day, PayPal min $1. 100M+ downloads. Best for US drivers wanting cheapest gas nearby + guaranteed cents off.

name: PrizeRebel
description: GPT platform combining cashback, surveys and offer walls. Founded 2007, 15M+ members, $30M+ paid. Low $2 gift card and $5 PayPal minimums with fast PayPal processing.

pros: $2 gift card minimum - lowest in GPT category
Fast PayPal often under 2 hours for veterans

Tiered loyalty boosts referral earnings to 30%
cons: No welcome cash bonus - only profile points
Cashback rates lower than dedicated cashback portals
Trustpilot lower than competitors due to task declines
reviewData.reviewBody:
PrizeRebel is a veteran GPT that has survived since 2007 by paying quickly. The $5 PayPal threshold is lower than Swagbucks and ySense, and veteran members report PayPal within hours, not days. Points value is simple: 1 cent per point.

Cashback isn't its strength - rates are average. It's best for surveys and offer walls when you need a quick $5 payout. Referral tier system is generous if you can bring active users.

Bank payout from $0 is good on paper but you need $0.50-$1 per receipt max. PayPal $10 min takes months. Better as passive backup to Fetch/Ibotta rather than primary.
